data.name: Ashil
data.long_meaning: The one who is little in age or in size, or the one who is born in the night, or the one who resembles the moon or the sun
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the belief in the unity and oneness of Allah (God) and the connection between the creator and the creation. The name Ashil is a reminder of the humility and dependency on Allah and the recognition of the divine power and wisdom.
data.numerology_meaning: A number of balance and harmony, indicating the potential for great artistic and creative abilities, as well as the ability to bring harmony and balance to others.

in_arabic.name: أشيل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الشديد والمتين

in_urdu.name: اشیل

This root is referenced in the Quranic context, describing the steadfastness of prophets and messengers. In Islamic tradition, Ashil connotes qualities of resilience, spiritual fortitude, and determination. Historically, the name has been appreciated across Muslim cultures for its powerful connotations, reflecting a personality that is steadfast and strong-willed. In contemporary usage, Ashil remains a meaningful choice for parents seeking a name that embodies spiritual and moral strength
